description: Calculates bacterial population after a given time using exponential growth formula: N(t) = N₀ × e^(rt) or N(t) = N₀ × 2^(t/doubling_time). (cost: 1 credit)

doubling_time.description: number, optional, population doubling time, hours, no default

growth_rate.description: number, optional, exponential growth rate, per hour, no default

initial_population.description: number, required, starting population size, cells, no default

time.description: number, required, time elapsed, hours, no default

name: calculate_bacterial_growth
